label: Exact deterministic transcript laws separate the blind history test from the supplied audit
paraphrase: In the two-bit history surrogate, for every finite length and deterministic adaptive policy on the blind interface, the exact probability law of the transcript fails to identify the stipulated past-event marker. The exact transcript law of the supplied one-action audit identifies it on the same inputs. Each model has a deterministic readout, so those laws are point masses, with no prior across models. Real historical truth, admissibility, stochastic matching and epistemic warrant are open.
